component.name: Wrighter
component.summary: Write, rewrite and finish your novel

description.p: Wrighter is a writing app for novelists. Outline your story, draft it, and edit it all the way to done.
It is a native Linux application, not a browser in a window.

While you draft, Wrighter keeps you moving: a live word count against your target, timed sprints, and a forward-only mode that locks the cursor so you stop climbing back up the page instead of writing the next one.

When you rewrite, it reads your prose and scores the things that weaken fiction: adverbs propping up weak verbs, passive sentences, cliches, filler, repeated words, and sentences that run too long. Every scene gets a score out of 100, so you know which one to open first and when a scene is finished.

Your novel has structure and Wrighter keeps it in front of you. Move between the outline, the corkboard and the full manuscript without losing your place. It tracks who is in each scene and where it happens, so you can follow a character's arc and see the shape of the conflict.

Wrighter has no AI in it. It will not write for you, and it never sends your manuscript anywhere. Turn sync on and your work follows you to Mac, iPhone, iPad, Windows and Android. Leave it off and nothing leaves this machine. If you would rather keep your files as plain Markdown on your own disk, you can.
Every subscription starts with a 7-day free trial. One licence covers every platform: £1.99 a month, £19.99 a year, or £49.99 once.
